facts.fact: StackAdapt recommends video ads be no longer than 30 seconds.
facts.quote: Your video should be no longer than 30 seconds, and use an aspect ratio of 16:9 (1920x1080p being the recommended size).

facts.fact: StackAdapt recommends a 16:9 aspect ratio for video ads, with 1920x1080p as the recommended size.
facts.quote: use an aspect ratio of 16:9 (1920x1080p being the recommended size).

facts.fact: Micro video ads run for 10 seconds or less.
facts.quote: Micro videos are a great option to include in your ad campaign's journey—these ads run for 10 seconds or less
